correctness.rationale: PASS: The unique gap vector w=b^g0 a b^g1 ... a b^gA gives C=Σ_{i=1}^A i*g_i and I=Σ_{i=1}^{A-1}g_i. Fixing I=s and terminal gap j=g_A leaves a complete homogeneous polynomial h_s(z,...,z^{A-1})=z^s [s+A-2 choose A-2]_z and a factor Σ_{j=0}^{B-s} z^{Aj}, establishing the entire bivariate polynomial and exact conditional fractions. The sharp support proof separately treats A=2 (C=s+2j, parity), A>=3 with s=0 or s=1, and 2<=s<=M where intervals [Aj+s, Aj+(A-1)s] touch because (A-2)s>=A-1. For A>=3 this gives 0 or 1 plus [2,M] depending on A|C. Scattered ab^t a iff I>=t is exact for first/last a, so corollaries follow including B=0. Fresh independent direct word-and-inversion counts for 35 pairs A=2..6,B=0..6 reproduced every joint coefficient and complete conditional support. Not an inference from bounded experiments.

These two consequences are covered and cannot be counted as novel.
